---DEP
SELECT SCHM_TYPE FROM busc.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER GROUP BY SCHM_TYPE --- 'SBA','CAA','TDA' only

---LNS

---DW
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(A.CustomerID)) FROM DW.DimCustomer A
    ---WHERE A.SourceSystemCode = 'CRM'
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount B ON A.CustomerSK = B.CustomerSK
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccountProduct C ON B.AccountSK = C.AccountSK
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimProduct D ON C.ProductSK = D.ProductSK
    WHERE D.FcbsApplication IN ('SBA','CAA','TDA','CLA', 'LAA')
---SourceSystemCode Filter: 3,126,329 unique Customer IDs
---SCHM_TYPE Filter: 2,912,756 unique Customer IDs

    LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccountProduct C ON B.AccountSK = C.AccountSK
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimProduct D ON C.ProductSK = D.ProductSK

    LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomerAccount B ON A.CustomerSK = B.CustomerSK
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccountProduct C ON B.AccountSK = C.AccountSK
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimProduct D ON C.ProductSK = D.ProductSK
    WHERE D.FcbsApplication IN ('SBA','CAA','TDA','CLA', 'LAA') AND B.AccountHolderTypeSK IN (12, 24,36,48)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
    ---Get list of unique CIFs with Deposit account
    SELECT DISTINCT(C.ORGKEY) FROM busc.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER A
        LEFT JOIN busc.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP B ON B.ACID = A.ACID
        LEFT JOIN busc.CRM_ACCOUNTS C ON C.CORE_CUST_ID = B.CUST_ID
        ---following filters for MV_SCV
        WHERE A.SCHM_TYPE IN ('SBA','CAA','TDA')
        AND A.DEL_FLG = 'N'
        AND A.ENTITY_CRE_FLG = 'Y'
        AND A.ACCT_OWNERSHIP IN ('C', 'E')
        AND A.FORACID IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    ---Get list of unique CIFs with Loan account
    SELECT DISTINCT(C.ORGKEY) FROM busc.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST A
        LEFT JOIN busc.LNS_ACCTAUTHSIGN B ON B.ACID = A.ACID
        LEFT JOIN busc.CRM_ACCOUNTS C ON C.CORE_CUST_ID = B.CUST_ID
        ---following filters for MV_SCV
        WHERE A.SCHM_TYPE IN ('CLA', 'LAA')
        AND A.DEL_FLG = 'N'
        AND A.ENTITY_CRE_FLG = 'Y'
        AND A.ACCT_OWNERSHIP IN ('C', 'E')
        AND A.FORACID IS NOT NULL) test

---Count list of unique CIFs that have either Deposit or Loan account
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
    ---Get list of unique CIFs with Deposit account
    SELECT DISTINCT(C.ORGKEY) FROM busc.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER A
        LEFT JOIN busc.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP B ON B.ACID = A.ACID
        LEFT JOIN busc.CRM_ACCOUNTS_BU_20230803 C ON C.CORE_CUST_ID = B.CUST_ID
        ---following filters for MV_SCV
        WHERE A.SCHM_TYPE IN ('SBA','CAA','TDA')
        AND A.DEL_FLG = 'N'

    UNION
    ---Get list of unique CIFs with Loan account
    SELECT DISTINCT(C.ORGKEY) FROM busc.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST A
        LEFT JOIN busc.LNS_ACCTAUTHSIGN B ON B.ACID = A.ACID
        LEFT JOIN busc.CRM_ACCOUNTS_BU_20230803 C ON C.CORE_CUST_ID = B.CUST_ID

        WHERE A.SCHM_TYPE IN ('CLA', 'LAA')

WITH DEP_GAM AS (
SELECT 
    CASE WHEN A.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' and A.ACCT_CLS_DATE <= '2022-12-31' and A.SCHM_TYPE in ('CAA','SBA','TDA') THEN 'Closed' 
        WHEN A.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'N' and A.SCHM_TYPE in ('SBA','CAA') THEN B.ACCT_STATUS 
        WHEN A.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' and A.ACCT_CLS_DATE > '2022-12-31' and A.SCHM_TYPE in ('CAA','SBA') THEN B.ACCT_STATUS 
        WHEN A.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y' and A.ACCT_CLS_DATE > '2022-12-31' and A.SCHM_TYPE in ('TDA') THEN C.ACCT_STATUS  
        WHEN A.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'N' and A.SCHM_TYPE in ('TDA') THEN C.ACCT_STATUS
        END as AccountStatus
    ,A.*
    FROM busc.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER A
    LEFT JOIN busc.DEP_CASAMASTER B ON B.ACID = A.ACID
    LEFT JOIN busc.DEP_TDMASTER C ON C.ACID = A.ACID
    ---WHERE A.IsLatest = 1 AND B.IsLatest = 1 AND C.IsLatest = 1
)
, LNS_GAM AS (
SELECT
    CASE WHEN B.PAYOFF_FLG = 'Y' and B.PAYOFF_DATE <= '2023-01-12' and A.SCHM_TYPE in ('LAA','CLA') THEN 'Closed' 
        WHEN B.PAYOFF_FLG = 'N' and A.SCHM_TYPE in ('LAA','CLA') THEN 'Active' 
        WHEN B.PAYOFF_FLG = 'Y' and B.PAYOFF_DATE > '2023-01-12' and A.SCHM_TYPE in ('LAA','CLA') THEN 'Active' 
        END as AccountStatus
    ,A.*
    FROM busc.LNS_GENERALACCTMAST A
    LEFT JOIN busc.LNS_LAACCTMAST B ON B.ACID = A.ACID
)
